source_text: Looking sharp, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Looking sharp, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Looking sharp, 1Hero."

translation: Elegancko wyglądasz, 1Hero.

source_text: Sending the boy to my dressing room, Paul?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe>.Sending the boy to my dressing room, Paul?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe>.Sending the boy to my dressing room, Paul?"

translation: Wysyłasz chłopaka do mojej garderoby, Paul?

source_text: Hey! No creeping, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx.Hey! No creeping, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx.Hey! No creeping, 1Hero."

translation: Hej! Nie podglądaj, 1Hero.

source_text: Please. Have a seat here, commissioner.

structure.raw_value: SeBaEx>.Please. Have a seat here, commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "SeBaEx>.Please. Have a seat here, commissioner."

translation: Proszę. Niech pani usiądzie tutaj, pani komisarz.

source_text: Take a seat next to Andrea, 1Hero. The sooner we start, the sooner we finish.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Take a seat next to Andrea, 1Hero. The sooner we start, the sooner we finish.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Take a seat next to Andrea, 1Hero. The sooner we start, the sooner we finish."

translation: Usiądź obok Andrei, 1Hero. Im szybciej zaczniemy, tym szybciej skończymy.

source_text: Are we live?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Are we live?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Are we live?"

translation: Jesteśmy na antenie?

source_text: Pre-recorded, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Pre-recorded, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Pre-recorded, 1Hero."

translation: To nagranie, 1Hero.

source_text: Oh…

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Oh…
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Oh…"

translation: Och…

source_text: Remember, 1Hero: Follow my lead.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx>.Remember, 1Hero: Follow my lead.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx>.Remember, 1Hero: Follow my lead."

translation: Pamiętaj, 1Hero: trzymaj się moich wskazówek.

source_text: You’re looking sharp. Relax and trust your instincts.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx>.You’re looking sharp. Relax and trust your instincts.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx>.You’re looking sharp. Relax and trust your instincts."

translation: Świetnie wyglądasz. Rozluźnij się i zaufaj instynktowi.

source_text: Sound check!

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp.Sound check!
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp.Sound check!"

translation: Próba dźwięku!

source_text: Sound check?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Sound check?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Sound check?"

translation: Próba dźwięku?

source_text: Perfect!

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp.Perfect!
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp.Perfect!"

translation: Idealnie!

source_text: Testing one, two.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Testing one, two.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Testing one, two."

translation: Próba, raz, dwa.

source_text: Ready in three, two, one…

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp.Ready in three, two, one…
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp.Ready in three, two, one…"

translation: Gotowi za trzy, dwa, jeden…

source_text: Talk about charisma. This town’s going to eat you right up, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Talk about charisma. This town’s going to eat you right up, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Talk about charisma. This town’s going to eat you right up, 1Hero."

translation: Ale masz charyzmę. To miasto cię pokocha, 1Hero.

source_text: I knew you had it in you.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp>.I knew you had it in you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp>.I knew you had it in you."

translation: Wiedziałam, że cię na to stać.

source_text: Alright, let’s review the footage and get it to editing.

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp.Alright, let’s review the footage and get it to editing.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp.Alright, let’s review the footage and get it to editing."

translation: Dobrze, obejrzyjmy nagranie i przekażmy je do montażu.

source_text: Careful, 1Hero. You can’t leave any doubt in the public’s mind.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. You can’t leave any doubt in the public’s mind.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. You can’t leave any doubt in the public’s mind."

translation: Uważaj, 1Hero. Nie możesz wzbudzić wątpliwości wśród ludzi.

source_text: You’ve implied that something could still happen here. We have to assure the public that they are safe.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.You’ve implied that something could still happen here. We have to assure the public that they are safe.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.You’ve implied that something could still happen here. We have to assure the public that they are safe."

translation: Zasugerowałeś, że coś może się tu jeszcze wydarzyć. Musimy zapewnić ludzi, że są bezpieczni.

source_text: But what about Duncan and Charles? Shouldn’t we hedge our bets just a little?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.But what about Duncan and Charles? Shouldn’t we hedge our bets just a little?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.But what about Duncan and Charles? Shouldn’t we hedge our bets just a little?"

translation: A co z Duncanem i Charlesem? Nie powinniśmy zostawić sobie choć odrobiny pola manewru?

source_text: I need to be able to trust you, 1Hero. We have a narrative to maintain.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I need to be able to trust you, 1Hero. We have a narrative to maintain.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I need to be able to trust you, 1Hero. We have a narrative to maintain."

translation: Muszę móc ci ufać, 1Hero. Musimy trzymać się ustalonej wersji wydarzeń.

source_text: I get it, but…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I get it, but…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I get it, but…"

translation: Rozumiem, ale…

source_text: You can’t give people any seeds of doubt or rumors will run wild.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You can’t give people any seeds of doubt or rumors will run wild.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You can’t give people any seeds of doubt or rumors will run wild."

translation: Nie możesz zasiewać wątpliwości, bo plotki wymkną się spod kontroli.

source_text: I think I understand.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I think I understand.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I think I understand."

translation: Chyba rozumiem.

source_text: You have one message, 1Hero: North Santiva is safe.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.You have one message, 1Hero: North Santiva is safe.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.You have one message, 1Hero: North Santiva is safe."

translation: Masz przekazać tylko jedno, 1Hero: North Santiva jest bezpieczna.

source_text: I won’t mention anything about Charles or Duncan.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I won’t mention anything about Charles or Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I won’t mention anything about Charles or Duncan."

translation: Nie wspomnę o Charlesie ani o Duncanie.

source_text: Your role is now public relations. I want you focused on keeping the people calm.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Your role is now public relations. I want you focused on keeping the people calm.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Your role is now public relations. I want you focused on keeping the people calm."

translation: Teraz odpowiadasz za public relations. Masz skupić się na uspokajaniu mieszkańców.

source_text: I’ll be watching you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.I’ll be watching you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.I’ll be watching you, 1Hero."

translation: Będę cię obserwować, 1Hero.

source_text: I can handle this, Andrea. You can count on me.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can handle this, Andrea. You can count on me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can handle this, Andrea. You can count on me."

translation: Poradzę sobie, Andreo. Możesz na mnie liczyć.

source_text: Now, don’t forget to turn up the charm for Miss Foxx.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Now, don’t forget to turn up the charm for Miss Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Now, don’t forget to turn up the charm for Miss Foxx."

translation: I pamiętaj, żeby oczarować pannę Foxx.

source_text: Without her alliance, our message will quickly break and a cycle of paranoia will stoke the fires of this news organization.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Without her alliance, our message will quickly break and a cycle of paranoia will stoke the fires of this news organization.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Without her alliance, our message will quickly break and a cycle of paranoia will stoke the fires of this news organization."

translation: Bez jej wsparcia nasz przekaz szybko się posypie, a spirala paranoi tylko podsyci atmosferę w redakcji.

source_text: She only cares about content. Keep her on our side and keep your lips sealed regarding anything having to do with North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.She only cares about content. Keep her on our side and keep your lips sealed regarding anything having to do with North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.She only cares about content. Keep her on our side and keep your lips sealed regarding anything having to do with North Santiva."

translation: Obchodzi ją tylko materiał. Trzymaj ją po naszej stronie i nie piśnij ani słowa o niczym, co dotyczy North Santivy.

source_text: This job will be easy if you make it easy.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.This job will be easy if you make it easy.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.This job will be easy if you make it easy."

translation: Ta praca będzie łatwa, jeśli jej nie utrudnisz.

source_text: We’re all good. The segment will make a perfect addition to this evening’s news.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.We’re all good. The segment will make a perfect addition to this evening’s news.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.We’re all good. The segment will make a perfect addition to this evening’s news."

translation: Wszystko gotowe. Ten materiał idealnie uzupełni dzisiejsze wieczorne wiadomości.

source_text: I can’t wait to watch it tonight.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.I can’t wait to watch it tonight.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.I can’t wait to watch it tonight."

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać, żeby obejrzeć go wieczorem.

source_text: If you don’t mind, I’ll be heading back to the station now.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.If you don’t mind, I’ll be heading back to the station now.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.If you don’t mind, I’ll be heading back to the station now."

translation: Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, wrócę teraz na komisariat.

source_text: Follow me, Miss Kimura.

structure.raw_value: SeBaEx>.Follow me, Miss Kimura.
structure.script_literal: "SeBaEx>.Follow me, Miss Kimura."

translation: Proszę za mną, pani Kimura.

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. Let’s chat back in the changing room.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Come on, 1Hero. Let’s chat back in the changing room.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Come on, 1Hero. Let’s chat back in the changing room."

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Pogadamy w garderobie.

source_text: Oh, uh. Okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Oh, uh. Okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Oh, uh. Okay."

translation: Och, eee… Dobrze.

source_text: So how long are we thinking before you make arrests?

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.So how long are we thinking before you make arrests?
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.So how long are we thinking before you make arrests?"

translation: Jak myślisz, kiedy dojdzie do aresztowań?

source_text: Soon, Paul. And when we do you’ll be the first person we call.

structure.raw_value: AdFrE^x.Soon, Paul. And when we do you’ll be the first person we call.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrE^x.Soon, Paul. And when we do you’ll be the first person we call."

translation: Wkrótce, Paul. A kiedy do nich dojdzie, zadzwonimy najpierw do ciebie.

source_text: Great job, 1Hero. You’re sure to capture the hearts of the viewers.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Great job, 1Hero. You’re sure to capture the hearts of the viewers.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Great job, 1Hero. You’re sure to capture the hearts of the viewers."

translation: Dobra robota, 1Hero. Z pewnością podbijesz serca widzów.

source_text: Let’s just hope this works.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Let’s just hope this works.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Let’s just hope this works."

translation: Miejmy nadzieję, że to zadziała.

source_text: So you think this broadcast will lure them out?

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.So you think this broadcast will lure them out?
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.So you think this broadcast will lure them out?"

translation: Myślisz, że ta transmisja ich wywabi?

source_text: The Guild thieves should believe they have a head start and should feel the pressure to find the painting first…

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.The Guild thieves should believe they have a head start and should feel the pressure to find the painting first…
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.The Guild thieves should believe they have a head start and should feel the pressure to find the painting first…"

translation: Złodzieje z Gildii powinni sądzić, że mają przewagę i poczuć presję, by jako pierwsi znaleźć obraz…

source_text: They’ll have no choice.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.They’ll have no choice.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.They’ll have no choice."

translation: Nie będą mieli wyboru.

source_text: This is going to be big. People love art heists.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.This is going to be big. People love art heists.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.This is going to be big. People love art heists."

translation: To będzie głośna sprawa. Ludzie uwielbiają kradzieże dzieł sztuki.

source_text: Hell yeah they do. This could give us news for weeks…

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Hell yeah they do. This could give us news for weeks…
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Hell yeah they do. This could give us news for weeks…"

translation: I to jak. Będziemy mieli temat na całe tygodnie…

source_text: Don’t rush the investigation, Commissioner.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx.Don’t rush the investigation, Commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx.Don’t rush the investigation, Commissioner."

translation: Proszę nie pospieszać śledztwa, pani komisarz.

source_text: Don’t worry, Paul. We’ll have plenty to give you.

structure.raw_value: AdFrOp^.Don’t worry, Paul. We’ll have plenty to give you.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrOp^.Don’t worry, Paul. We’ll have plenty to give you."

translation: Nie martw się, Paul. Dostarczymy ci mnóstwo materiału.

source_text: So what’s the name of the painting?

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.So what’s the name of the painting?
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.So what’s the name of the painting?"

translation: Jak się nazywa ten obraz?

source_text: Not yet. Let’s plan another interview next week.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx^.Not yet. Let’s plan another interview next week.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx^.Not yet. Let’s plan another interview next week."

translation: Jeszcze nie wiem. Zaplanujmy kolejny wywiad na przyszły tydzień.

source_text: We get it. We won’t interfere.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.We get it. We won’t interfere.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.We get it. We won’t interfere."

translation: Rozumiemy. Nie będziemy przeszkadzać.

source_text: If you’ll excuse me, I must head home.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx^.If you’ll excuse me, I must head home.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx^.If you’ll excuse me, I must head home."

translation: Jeśli państwo pozwolą, muszę wracać do domu.

source_text: Thanks, Commissioner.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Thanks, Commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Thanks, Commissioner."

translation: Dziękuję, pani komisarz.

source_text: You know I always come through, Paul.

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp^.You know I always come through, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp^.You know I always come through, Paul."

translation: Wiesz, że zawsze można na mnie liczyć, Paul.

source_text: Great job, you two! People are loving Detective Canmore. A true model detective for our community to look up to.

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp.Great job, you two! People are loving Detective Canmore. A true model detective for our community to look up to.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp.Great job, you two! People are loving Detective Canmore. A true model detective for our community to look up to."

translation: Świetna robota, oboje! Widzowie uwielbiają detektywa Canmore’a. To wzór detektywa dla naszej społeczności.

source_text: Alright. Enough praise. Let him get back to work.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.Alright. Enough praise. Let him get back to work.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.Alright. Enough praise. Let him get back to work."

translation: Dobrze, dość pochwał. Niech wraca do pracy.

source_text: And, 1Hero. We’ll keep our little secret close to the chest.

structure.raw_value: PlFlOp.And, 1Hero. We’ll keep our little secret close to the chest.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlOp.And, 1Hero. We’ll keep our little secret close to the chest."

translation: A, 1Hero. Nasz mały sekret zostanie między nami.

source_text: He knows about the transmitters?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.He knows about the transmitters?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.He knows about the transmitters?"

translation: Wie o nadajnikach?

source_text: We’ll play Kimura’s game, but we want more.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.We’ll play Kimura’s game, but we want more.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.We’ll play Kimura’s game, but we want more."

translation: Zagramy w grę Kimury, ale chcemy czegoś więcej.

source_text: If you get caught, I’ll deny everything.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.If you get caught, I’ll deny everything.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.If you get caught, I’ll deny everything."

translation: Jeśli cię złapią, wszystkiemu zaprzeczę.

source_text: Of course. I’d expect no less.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Of course. I’d expect no less.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Of course. I’d expect no less."

translation: Oczywiście. Niczego innego się nie spodziewałam.

source_text: But we won't get caught.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.But we won't get caught.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.But we won't get caught."

translation: Ale nie damy się złapać.

source_text: I’ll get that transmitter fixed. This case goes deeper than the Eclipse Guild and I want to know what’s happening.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ll get that transmitter fixed. This case goes deeper than the Eclipse Guild and I want to know what’s happening.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ll get that transmitter fixed. This case goes deeper than the Eclipse Guild and I want to know what’s happening."

translation: Naprawię ten nadajnik. Ta sprawa sięga dalej niż Gildia Zaćmienia i chcę wiedzieć, co się dzieje.

source_text: You bend the rules, 1Hero. You should be working here.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.You bend the rules, 1Hero. You should be working here.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.You bend the rules, 1Hero. You should be working here."

translation: Ty to potrafisz naginać zasady, 1Hero. Powinieneś pracować u nas.

source_text: I think I’ll keep kissing up to Andrea and maybe one day I’ll be commissioner myself.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I think I’ll keep kissing up to Andrea and maybe one day I’ll be commissioner myself.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I think I’ll keep kissing up to Andrea and maybe one day I’ll be commissioner myself."

translation: Chyba dalej będę się podlizywać Andrei. Może kiedyś sam zostanę komisarzem.

source_text: Keep dreaming, detective.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Keep dreaming, detective.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Keep dreaming, detective."

translation: Śnij dalej, detektywie.

source_text: Just in time. We go live in five minutes.

structure.raw_value: PlHaEx^.Just in time. We go live in five minutes.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaEx^.Just in time. We go live in five minutes."

translation: W samą porę. Za pięć minut wchodzimy na żywo.

source_text: How does she look?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.How does she look?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.How does she look?"

translation: Jak wygląda?

source_text: Keep the closeups on 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: PlFlEx^.Keep the closeups on 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlEx^.Keep the closeups on 1Hero."

translation: Zbliżenia na 1Hero.

source_text: Our jobs are on the line. If this doesn’t go well, we’re fired.

structure.raw_value: MeWoOp^.Our jobs are on the line. If this doesn’t go well, we’re fired.
structure.script_literal: "MeWoOp^.Our jobs are on the line. If this doesn’t go well, we’re fired."

translation: Od tego zależą nasze posady. Jeśli coś pójdzie nie tak, wylecimy.

source_text: You took down the Guild. They won’t fire you after this broadcast.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.You took down the Guild. They won’t fire you after this broadcast.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.You took down the Guild. They won’t fire you after this broadcast."

translation: Rozbiłeś Gildię. Nie zwolnią cię po tej transmisji.

source_text: It might not be over.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.It might not be over.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.It might not be over."

translation: To może jeszcze nie być koniec.

source_text: Get your story straight, you two. We’re going live.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.Get your story straight, you two. We’re going live.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.Get your story straight, you two. We’re going live."

translation: Ustalcie wspólną wersję. Zaraz wchodzimy na żywo.

source_text: Get seated. We go live in thirty seconds.

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx^.Get seated. We go live in thirty seconds.
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx^.Get seated. We go live in thirty seconds."

translation: Siadajcie. Za trzydzieści sekund wchodzimy na żywo.

source_text: Cut! And we’re done with the live coverage.

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp^.Cut! And we’re done with the live coverage.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp^.Cut! And we’re done with the live coverage."

translation: Cięcie! Koniec transmisji na żywo.

source_text: Andrea isn’t going to like that last part about the undercover agents.

structure.raw_value: MeWoOp^.Andrea isn’t going to like that last part about the undercover agents.
structure.script_literal: "MeWoOp^.Andrea isn’t going to like that last part about the undercover agents."

translation: Andrea nie spodoba się ta końcówka o tajniakach.

source_text: Just trying to cover for Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Just trying to cover for Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Just trying to cover for Nellie."

translation: Próbowałem tylko kryć Nellie.

source_text: Great job, you two.

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Great job, you two.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Great job, you two."

translation: Dobra robota, oboje.

source_text: That’s a wrap, everyone. Thanks for staying late.

structure.raw_value: PlHaEx^.That’s a wrap, everyone. Thanks for staying late.
structure.script_literal: "PlHaEx^.That’s a wrap, everyone. Thanks for staying late."

translation: I to by było na tyle. Dziękuję wszystkim, że zostaliście po godzinach.

source_text: I’m going to take off. I’ll see you bright and early tomorrow, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx^.I’m going to take off. I’ll see you bright and early tomorrow, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx^.I’m going to take off. I’ll see you bright and early tomorrow, Kimberly."

translation: Zmykam. Do zobaczenia jutro z samego rana, Kimberly.

source_text: Thanks, Paul.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Thanks, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Thanks, Paul."

translation: Dzięki, Paul.

source_text: We make a great team, Foxx.

structure.raw_value: PlFlOp^.We make a great team, Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "PlFlOp^.We make a great team, Foxx."

translation: Stanowimy zgrany zespół, Foxx.

source_text: I hope that was enough.

structure.raw_value: MeWoOp^.I hope that was enough.
structure.script_literal: "MeWoOp^.I hope that was enough."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że to wystarczyło.

source_text: Not sure why the commissioner would fire you after this…

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Not sure why the commissioner would fire you after this…
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Not sure why the commissioner would fire you after this…"

translation: Nie wiem, czemu komisarz miałaby cię zwolnić po czymś takim…

structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl^.Hopefully not!"

translation: Arianno… Pomożesz nam ją zniszczyć?

source_text: Lilith is more powerful than I am… But we have the Lord on our side.

structure.raw_value: ErFrEx^.Lilith is more powerful than I am… But we have the Lord on our side.
structure.script_literal: "ErFrEx^.Lilith is more powerful than I am… But we have the Lord on our side."

translation: Lilith jest potężniejsza ode mnie… Ale Pan jest po naszej stronie.

source_text: What about Erica? Did she have the Lord on her side, too?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.What about Erica? Did she have the Lord on her side, too?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.What about Erica? Did she have the Lord on her side, too?"

translation: A co z Eriką? Pan też był po jej stronie?

source_text: 1Hero…

structure.raw_value: ErSaOp^.1Hero…
structure.script_literal: "ErSaOp^.1Hero…"

translation: 1Hero…

source_text: You told me the path was being laid out for me… That I would be doing God’s will.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You told me the path was being laid out for me… That I would be doing God’s will.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You told me the path was being laid out for me… That I would be doing God’s will."

translation: Mówiłaś, że wytyczono mi drogę… Że będę wypełniał wolę Boga.

source_text: It’s true.

structure.raw_value: ErSaEx^.It’s true.
structure.script_literal: "ErSaEx^.It’s true."

translation: To prawda.

source_text: I’m going back to Hell and I’m going to kill Lilith.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m going back to Hell and I’m going to kill Lilith.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m going back to Hell and I’m going to kill Lilith."

translation: Wracam do piekła i zabiję Lilith.

source_text: I can’t fail.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I can’t fail.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I can’t fail."

translation: Nie mogę zawieść.

source_text: But is it God’s will?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl^.But is it God’s will?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl^.But is it God’s will?"

translation: Ale czy taka jest wola Boga?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It is now.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It is now."

translation: Teraz już tak.

source_text: What the hell happened? Where is Kimberly?

structure.raw_value: SeWoOp.What the hell happened? Where is Kimberly?
structure.script_literal: "SeWoOp.What the hell happened? Where is Kimberly?"

translation: Co się, do cholery, stało? Gdzie jest Kimberly?

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.We stopped the broadcast… but she got away.

translation: Przerwaliśmy transmisję… ale uciekła.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She'll be okay... It's hard to explain, but she'll be fine.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She'll be okay... It's hard to explain, but she'll be fine."

translation: Nic jej nie będzie… Trudno to wyjaśnić, ale wszystko z nią będzie dobrze.

structure.script_literal: "PlBaDe.Our interviewees for the sex segment should be here any moment now…"

translation: Nasi rozmówcy do segmentu o seksie powinni zaraz się zjawić…

source_text: Ah, Ms. Bancroft!

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Ah, Ms. Bancroft!
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Ah, Ms. Bancroft!"

translation: Ach, pani Bancroft!

source_text: Such a pleasure to see you again. It’s been a long time.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Such a pleasure to see you again. It’s been a long time.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Such a pleasure to see you again. It’s been a long time."

translation: Miło panią znów widzieć. Dawno się nie widzieliśmy.

source_text: Let me introduce you to Kimberly Foxx, our star anchor.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Let me introduce you to Kimberly Foxx, our star anchor.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Let me introduce you to Kimberly Foxx, our star anchor."

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp>.It’s good to meet you, Ms. Bancroft. I look forward to our interview.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp>.It’s good to meet you, Ms. Bancroft. I look forward to our interview."

translation: Miło mi panią poznać, pani Bancroft. Cieszę się na nasz wywiad.

source_text: Likewise, Ms. Foxx. I hope this interview goes better than last time I was here.

structure.raw_value: AmFrOp.Likewise, Ms. Foxx. I hope this interview goes better than last time I was here.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrOp.Likewise, Ms. Foxx. I hope this interview goes better than last time I was here."

translation: Również mi miło, pani Foxx. Mam nadzieję, że tym razem wywiad pójdzie lepiej niż ostatnio.

source_text: I’m sure everything will go well.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx>.I’m sure everything will go well.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx>.I’m sure everything will go well."

translation: Na pewno wszystko pójdzie dobrze.

source_text: And, as a bonus, we happen to have with us today North Santiva’s celebrity detective, 1Hero Canmore.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.And, as a bonus, we happen to have with us today North Santiva’s celebrity detective, 1Hero Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.And, as a bonus, we happen to have with us today North Santiva’s celebrity detective, 1Hero Canmore."

translation: A w bonusie mamy dziś z nami słynnego detektywa z North Santivy, 1Hero Canmore.

source_text: Detective, let me introduce you to Amanda Bancroft, the CEO of Sensular Labs.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Detective, let me introduce you to Amanda Bancroft, the CEO of Sensular Labs.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Detective, let me introduce you to Amanda Bancroft, the CEO of Sensular Labs."

translation: Detektywie, pozwolę sobie przedstawić panią Amandę Bancroft, dyrektorkę generalną Sensular Labs.

source_text: It’s a pleasure to meet you, Detective Canmore. You’re quite famous.

structure.raw_value: AmFrOp^.It’s a pleasure to meet you, Detective Canmore. You’re quite famous.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrOp^.It’s a pleasure to meet you, Detective Canmore. You’re quite famous."

translation: Miło mi pana poznać, detektywie Canmore. Jest pan całkiem sławny.

source_text: Haha, I guess so. Your love potion has been making headlines, too.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo3.Haha, I guess so. Your love potion has been making headlines, too.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOpNo3.Haha, I guess so. Your love potion has been making headlines, too."

translation: Haha, chyba tak. Pani eliksir miłosny też nie schodzi z nagłówków.

source_text: Have you tried it? It’ll rock your socks off.

structure.raw_value: AmFlOp^.Have you tried it? It’ll rock your socks off.
structure.script_literal: "AmFlOp^.Have you tried it? It’ll rock your socks off."

translation: Próbował pan? Zwali pana z nóg.

source_text: Honestly, I’ve only tried the competing brand.

structure.raw_value: McFlDeNo4.Honestly, I’ve only tried the competing brand.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDeNo4.Honestly, I’ve only tried the competing brand."

translation: Szczerze mówiąc, próbowałem tylko konkurencyjnego produktu.

source_text: Seems my competition has a deal with this town.

structure.raw_value: AmAnDe^.Seems my competition has a deal with this town.
structure.script_literal: "AmAnDe^.Seems my competition has a deal with this town."

translation: Wygląda na to, że moja konkurencja ma układ z tym miastem.

source_text: Is this equipment built to standard? Where are the permits for the cameras?

structure.raw_value: SiFrCl.Is this equipment built to standard? Where are the permits for the cameras?
structure.script_literal: "SiFrCl.Is this equipment built to standard? Where are the permits for the cameras?"

translation: Czy ten sprzęt spełnia normy? Gdzie są pozwolenia na kamery?

source_text: Everyone, this is my son, Simon.

structure.raw_value: AmFrEx^.Everyone, this is my son, Simon.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrEx^.Everyone, this is my son, Simon."

translation: Wszyscy, to mój syn, Simon.

source_text: Good to meet you, son.

structure.raw_value: PlFrOp.Good to meet you, son.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrOp.Good to meet you, son."

translation: Miło cię poznać, synu.

source_text: So a detective, huh? I have some experience with guns myself, you know.

structure.raw_value: SiFlDe.So a detective, huh? I have some experience with guns myself, you know.
structure.script_literal: "SiFlDe.So a detective, huh? I have some experience with guns myself, you know."

translation: Czyli jesteś detektywem, co? Sam też mam pewne doświadczenie z bronią.

source_text: Uh, is that right?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Uh, is that right?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Uh, is that right?"

translation: Aha, tak?

source_text: Simon!

structure.raw_value: AmAnDe!c^.Simon!
structure.script_literal: "AmAnDe!c^.Simon!"

translation: Simon!

source_text: And I know a thing or two about security. I learned from the best!

structure.raw_value: SiFrDe.And I know a thing or two about security. I learned from the best!
structure.script_literal: "SiFrDe.And I know a thing or two about security. I learned from the best!"

translation: Znam się też trochę na ochronie. Uczyłem się od najlepszych!

source_text: The best?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.The best?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.The best?"

source_text: Simon, stop talking.

structure.raw_value: AmAnDe^.Simon, stop talking.

structure.raw_value: SiAnDe.I smell a trap… This better not be another news segment on that old ESU sex scandal.
structure.script_literal: "SiAnDe.I smell a trap… This better not be another news segment on that old ESU sex scandal."

translation: Wyczuwam podstęp… To nie może być kolejny materiał o dawnym skandalu seksualnym ESU.

structure.raw_value: AmAnOp^.Simon! I said, be quiet!
structure.script_literal: "AmAnOp^.Simon! I said, be quiet!"

translation: Simon! Mówiłam, żebyś był cicho!

source_text: I’m sure Paul knows why we are here, and it’s not to talk about the past.

structure.raw_value: AmFrDe^.I’m sure Paul knows why we are here, and it’s not to talk about the past.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrDe^.I’m sure Paul knows why we are here, and it’s not to talk about the past."

translation: Jestem pewna, że Paul wie, po co tu jesteśmy. Nie po to, by rozmawiać o przeszłości.

source_text: Of course…

structure.raw_value: PlFrDe.Of course…
structure.script_literal: "PlFrDe.Of course…"

translation: Oczywiście…

source_text: Well, it’s about time for the interview. So if you don’t mind, Ms. Bancroft, right this way…

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.Well, it’s about time for the interview. So if you don’t mind, Ms. Bancroft, right this way…
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.Well, it’s about time for the interview. So if you don’t mind, Ms. Bancroft, right this way…"

translation: Cóż, pora na wywiad. Jeśli pani pozwoli, pani Bancroft, tędy…

source_text: Simon, how about you wait outside?

structure.raw_value: AmBaEx>.Simon, how about you wait outside?
structure.script_literal: "AmBaEx>.Simon, how about you wait outside?"

translation: Simon, może poczekasz na zewnątrz?

source_text: But, Mom!...

structure.raw_value: SiWoAg.But, Mom!...
structure.script_literal: "SiWoAg.But, Mom!..."

translation: Ale, mamo!...

source_text: I said, outside!

structure.raw_value: AmAnEx>.I said, outside!
structure.script_literal: "AmAnEx>.I said, outside!"

translation: Powiedziałam: na zewnątrz!

source_text: Wait, Simon.

structure.raw_value: AmBaOp>.Wait, Simon.
structure.script_literal: "AmBaOp>.Wait, Simon."

translation: Zaczekaj, Simon.

source_text: Paul, can you make sure security keeps him company? There’s no telling what he’ll get up to on his own.

structure.raw_value: AmWoOp^.Paul, can you make sure security keeps him company? There’s no telling what he’ll get up to on his own.
structure.script_literal: "AmWoOp^.Paul, can you make sure security keeps him company? There’s no telling what he’ll get up to on his own."

translation: Paul, możesz poprosić ochronę, żeby dotrzymała mu towarzystwa? Nie wiadomo, co wymyśli, gdy zostanie sam.

source_text: I’m sorry, Ms. Bancroft, but our security is too busy to look after… an adult?

structure.raw_value: PlBaDe.I’m sorry, Ms. Bancroft, but our security is too busy to look after… an adult?
structure.script_literal: "PlBaDe.I’m sorry, Ms. Bancroft, but our security is too busy to look after… an adult?"

translation: Przykro mi, pani Bancroft, ale ochrona jest zbyt zajęta, żeby pilnować… dorosłego?

source_text: Hardly.

structure.raw_value: AmAnDe^.Hardly.
structure.script_literal: "AmAnDe^.Hardly."

translation: Nie bardzo.

source_text: Detective! You deal with him.

structure.raw_value: AmFrEx^.Detective! You deal with him.

translation: Detektywie! Pan się nim zajmie.

source_text: Make sure my son doesn’t hurt himself.

structure.raw_value: AmFrOp^.Make sure my son doesn’t hurt himself.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrOp^.Make sure my son doesn’t hurt himself."

translation: Proszę dopilnować, żeby mój syn nie zrobił sobie krzywdy.

source_text: I’m not a babysitter.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I’m not a babysitter.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I’m not a babysitter."

translation: Nie jestem niańką.

structure.raw_value: SiMaAg.Hey, I’m not a baby!
structure.script_literal: "SiMaAg.Hey, I’m not a baby!"

translation: Hej, nie jestem dzieckiem!

source_text: 1Hero, please. We’re all friends here, right?

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.1Hero, please. We’re all friends here, right?
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.1Hero, please. We’re all friends here, right?"

translation: 1Hero, proszę. Jesteśmy tu wszyscy przyjaciółmi, prawda?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp^.Come on, 1Hero. It’s just for a little while.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp^.Come on, 1Hero. It’s just for a little while."

translation: No już, 1Hero. To tylko na chwilę.

source_text: If left to his own devices, there’s no telling what my son will get up to.

structure.raw_value: AmWoDe^.If left to his own devices, there’s no telling what my son will get up to.
structure.script_literal: "AmWoDe^.If left to his own devices, there’s no telling what my son will get up to."

translation: Jeśli zostawić go samemu sobie, nie wiadomo, co mój syn wymyśli.

source_text: You know I’m standing right here?

structure.raw_value: SiAnDe.You know I’m standing right here?
structure.script_literal: "SiAnDe.You know I’m standing right here?"

translation: Wiecie, że stoję tuż obok?

source_text: But you owe me for this, Kim.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.But you owe me for this, Kim.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.But you owe me for this, Kim."

translation: Ale jesteś mi za to coś winna, Kim.

source_text: I look forward to paying up.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp^.I look forward to paying up.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp^.I look forward to paying up."

translation: Już nie mogę się doczekać, aż spłacę dług.

source_text: Come on, Simon. How about we go make sure the building is secure, or something?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Come on, Simon. How about we go make sure the building is secure, or something?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Come on, Simon. How about we go make sure the building is secure, or something?"

translation: Chodź, Simon. Może sprawdzimy, czy budynek jest bezpieczny, czy coś?

structure.raw_value: SiHaAg.Oh, yeah? I know all about that! Buddy taught me everything he knew about security!
structure.script_literal: "SiHaAg.Oh, yeah? I know all about that! Buddy taught me everything he knew about security!"

translation: Tak? Ja się na tym znam! Buddy nauczył mnie wszystkiego, co wiedział o ochronie!

structure.raw_value: SiFrEx.Don’t worry, Detective Canmore! I’ve got this!
structure.script_literal: "SiFrEx.Don’t worry, Detective Canmore! I’ve got this!"

translation: Proszę się nie martwić, detektywie Canmore! Zajmę się tym!

source_text: There he goes.

structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe^.There he goes."

translation: No i poszedł.

source_text: What am I going to do with that boy?

structure.raw_value: AmAnOp^.What am I going to do with that boy?
structure.script_literal: "AmAnOp^.What am I going to do with that boy?"

translation: Co ja mam z tym chłopakiem zrobić?

source_text: It’s time for the interview, Ms. Bancroft.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx.It’s time for the interview, Ms. Bancroft.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx.It’s time for the interview, Ms. Bancroft."

translation: Pani Bancroft, pora na wywiad.

source_text: 1Hero, what are you doing? We’re live! Go find Simon.

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx.1Hero, what are you doing? We’re live! Go find Simon.
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx.1Hero, what are you doing? We’re live! Go find Simon."

translation: 1Hero, co ty wyprawiasz? Jesteśmy na antenie! Znajdź Simona.

source_text: I’m a bit busy right now, as you can see. Shouldn’t you be looking after that Bancroft kid?

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx.I’m a bit busy right now, as you can see. Shouldn’t you be looking after that Bancroft kid?
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx.I’m a bit busy right now, as you can see. Shouldn’t you be looking after that Bancroft kid?"

translation: Jak widzisz, jestem teraz trochę zajęty. Nie powinieneś pilnować tego dzieciaka Bancrofta?

source_text: … and that’s what my company and our product is all about.

structure.raw_value: AmFrEx>.… and that’s what my company and our product is all about.
structure.script_literal: "AmFrEx>.… and that’s what my company and our product is all about."

translation: … i właśnie na tym polega działalność mojej firmy oraz jej produktu.

source_text: Fascinating, Ms. Bancroft.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Fascinating, Ms. Bancroft.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Fascinating, Ms. Bancroft."

translation: Fascynujące, pani Bancroft.

source_text: But I think a lot of our viewers want to know more about a certain rumor going around…

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.But I think a lot of our viewers want to know more about a certain rumor going around…
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.But I think a lot of our viewers want to know more about a certain rumor going around…"

translation: Wielu naszych widzów chciałoby jednak usłyszeć więcej o pewnej krążącej plotce…

source_text: Some say your company’s product is what’s responsible for the so-called sex virus outbreak.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Some say your company’s product is what’s responsible for the so-called sex virus outbreak.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Some say your company’s product is what’s responsible for the so-called sex virus outbreak."

translation: Niektórzy twierdzą, że za epidemię tak zwanego wirusa seksualnego odpowiada produkt pani firmy.

structure.script_literal: "AmAnOp>.Ms. Foxx, that’s absolutely ridiculous. "

structure.script_literal: "AmFrOp>.I assure you and your viewers that my company has nothing to do with the sex virus."

translation: Zapewniam panią i widzów, że moja firma nie ma nic wspólnego z wirusem seksualnym.

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.You must admit that it’s a strange coincidence, the sex virus outbreak happening just as your love potion becomes popular.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.You must admit that it’s a strange coincidence, the sex virus outbreak happening just as your love potion becomes popular."

translation: Musi pani przyznać, że to dziwny zbieg okoliczności: epidemia wirusa seksualnego wybucha akurat wtedy, gdy popularność zdobywa pani eliksir miłosny.

source_text: Pure coincidence, nothing more.

structure.raw_value: AmBaOp>.Pure coincidence, nothing more.
structure.script_literal: "AmBaOp>.Pure coincidence, nothing more."
